citations.quote:
# EXP-ECDLP-efafc0
# One chord on a toy Weierstrass curve. No solver benchmark.
# Approved by DEC-20261001-a2a4f4.
experiment:
  id: EXP-ECDLP-efafc0
  hypothesis_id: H-ECDLP-db6960
  source_idea: IDEA-20260918-5a9a51
  question_id: RQ-ECDLP-002
  version: 1
  title: Chord-and-tangent check of one triple over F_17
  status: approved
  frozen: true
  designed_at: '2026-10-01'
  approved_by: coordinator
  approval_decision_id: DEC-20261001-a2a4f4
  objective: >-
    On y^2 = x^3 + x + 1 over F_17, check that (0, 1), (4, 1), and (13, 16)
    lie on the curve and are collinear, and that the sum of the first two
    is (13, 1). Reject the control triple (0, 1), (4, 1), (0, 16).
  inputs:
    p: 17
    A: 1
    B: 1
    chord: [[0, 1], [4, 1], [13, 16]]
    predicted_sum: [13, 1]
    control_triple: [[0, 1], [4, 1], [0, 16]]
  controls:
    - The control triple is not collinear. Reporting it collinear invalidates the run.
    - Two routes, slope and cubic restriction. They must not import each other.
  independent_variables:
    - route
    - triple in {chord, control}
  metrics:
    primary:
      - points_on_curve
      - third_intersection
      - sum_of_first_two
      - control_collinear
      - routes_agree
    secondary:
      - slope
  heuristic_under_test: null
  preregistered_prediction:
    quantity: Third intersection and group-law sum.
    formula: >-
      Slope lambda = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1). Third x-coordinate is
      lambda^2 - x1 - x2. The sum is the negation of that third point.
    source: >-
      Design-time search on 2026-10-01 found the triple. IDEA-20260918-5a9a51
      was read for the elliptic-control requirement. ePrint 2015/179 was
      not fetched. The search is not a run.
  scale_relevance:
    tier: toy
    justification: One curve over F_17. No transfer to a hyperelliptic family.
    correspondence: null
  tail_checks:
    - The point at infinity is not used as a substitute for (13, 16).
  replication:
    seeds: []
    independent_instances: 1
    replication_note: Deterministic. The second run is the other route.
  budget:
    enforcement: advisory
    wall_clock_seconds_per_run: null
    total_cpu_hours: null
    maximum_memory_gb: 1
    maximum_runs: 2
    maximum_workers: 1
  stopping_rules:
    - Stop after two runs.
    - If the control triple is reported collinear, mark the attempt invalid.
    - A crash is incomplete, not a negative result.
  invalidation_rules:
    - Either route imports the other.
    - control_collinear is true.
    - A cost-per-relation or a discrete logarithm is reported.
  success_criterion: >-
    Both routes agree, all three chord points lie on the curve, the third
    intersection is (13, 16), the sum of the first two is (13, 1), and the
    control triple is not collinear.
  falsification_criterion: >-
    The routes agree, the control is not collinear, and the third
    intersection is not (13, 16) or the sum is not (13, 1).
  required_artifacts:
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/manifest.yaml
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/command.txt
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/stdout.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/stderr.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/raw-result.json
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-efafc0/runs/<RUN-ID>/certificate.yaml
  assigned_to: executor
  out_of_scope:
    - Hyperelliptic incidence search and cost ladders.
    - The unread ePrint named by the proposal.
    - The CERTBIN pricing design withheld by DEC-20261001-92f749.
citations.retrieved_by: oracle_integration implementation session 2026-10-18; no scientific execution

definition_notes: Keep original predicted third_intersection=(13,16), sum=(13,1), and chord collinearity unmodified. An independently agreeing, control-passing arithmetic contradiction is valid with prediction_match:false.
